title: Plancherel identity for product functions
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set with probability mass function $\pi$, and let $B$ be a finite Fourier basis on $\Omega$ indexed by a finite nonempty set $\iota$. For any two functions $f,g:(\Omega^n)\to\mathbb R$, their inner product under the product probability measure equals the sum of the products of their Fourier coefficients: $\langle f,g\rangle=\sum_{a\in\iota^n}\widehat f(a)\widehat g(a)$.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
$B$ is a finite Fourier basis indexed by a finite nonempty set
